verdict.rationale: WezTerm is a terminal emulator and multiplexer. It holds no production data of its own and has no service environment to mirror, so a vendor sandbox or test environment is the wrong axis for this kind of product. Its ability to SSH or multiplex into other hosts is only a user-side arrangement and does not make the axis apply, and nothing in the evidence shows WezTerm shipping a sandbox mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
